title: 53 Muhly Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 53 Muhly Circle is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 10) Private Pool with Outdoor Lounge Space 6 Adult Bikes Included 6 Passenger Electric Cart Included Propane Gas Grill Parking for Up to 3 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available) Outdoor Fireplace 6 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside 8 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Watercolor Beach Club Access DETAILS:Welcome to 53 Muhly Circle—a beautifully designed 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat nestled in the sought-after Crossings District of WaterColor. Offering over 3,200 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space, this home strikes the perfect balance between elevated entertaining and relaxed coastal living. Step inside to meticulous 12-foot ceilings and an open-concept layout filled with natural light. The heart of the home is a stunning chef’s kitchen featuring marble countertops, a spacious island with seating for six, and an adjacent wet bar complete with a Sub-Zero wine fridge and ice maker—perfect for gathering with friends and family. The home’s layout is thoughtfully designed for comfort and privacy, featuring two luxurious primary king suites—one on each level—each with spa-inspired bathrooms boasting soaking tubs and walk-in showers. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional king bedrooms and a cozy twin-over-twin bunk room, all offering stylish finishes and convenient bathroom access, making it ideal for families or groups traveling together. Outside, enjoy your own private oasis with a sparkling pool and multiple covered porches designed for lounging, dining, and unwinding in true 30A style. During your stay, you’ll also have six adult bikes and a 6-passenger electric cart at your disposal—perfect for exploring WaterColor’s scenic paths, nearby parks, and the charming shops and restaurants along iconic 30A. As a guest of WaterColor, you’ll have access to an incredible array of amenities, including the newly expanded Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, multiple resort-style pools, tennis courts, playgrounds, miles of nature trails, and the boathouse offering kayak and paddleboard rentals on Western Lake. 53 Muhly Circle is a stunning escape where comfort meets coastal elegance—and with the dedicated service of Sanders Beach Rentals, every detail of your stay is thoughtfully handled to ensure an unforgettable experience.
